impact: Continued Asian chip weakness keeps MU, DRAM and SNXX under pressure into Nvidia's report after the US close.
summary: Taiwan's Taiex fell about 1.7% to roughly 40,335 on Tuesday after Monday's 6% plunge led by TSMC. Japan's Nikkei fell about 1% to 1.3% and the Kospi about 1%, with Samsung down 2.4%, as chip stocks slid ahead of Nvidia's results and new US chip curbs. Options price about a 7.8% Nvidia move after earnings.
title: Taiwan's Taiex falls another 1.7% after Monday's 6% crash
